rationale: Robert and Kaushik both work at the intersection of ML and systems-level engineering — Robert as CTO building data and ML infrastructure at Capes, and Kaushik as a Senior ML Engineer applying ML to robotics and embedded systems at Mytra. They share Python as a core language and could explore how infrastructure patterns from one domain (data pipelines, model serving) might apply to the other (autonomous systems, real-time constraints).
intro_message: Robert Amanfu, meet Kaushik Prakash — you're both deep in ML implementation (infrastructure vs. robotics) and could swap approaches on Python-based systems at scale.
